project_claim: The candidate identified onboarding friction through five user interviews and removed mandatory account creation from the MVP.

sources.content: Five target-user interviews found that account creation blocked first use; the MVP decision was changed to guest-first analysis.

gold_label.boundary: Supports documented interviews and the resulting scope change; does not prove improved activation or broader market demand.

review_notes: The source directly connects observed users, a task barrier, and a decision.

project_claim: The candidate scoped the MVP to one project and one JD after rejecting multi-project ranking.

sources.content: Decision: support one project and one JD. Alternative rejected: multi-project ranking. Reason: it increases intake and evaluation complexity before the core evidence workflow is proven. Release gate: one grounded Application Pack validates.

gold_label.boundary: Supports the recorded scope, rejected alternative, rationale, and release gate; does not prove that the chosen scope creates user value.

review_notes: The decision artifact satisfies all parts of the scope evidence test.

project_claim: The candidate defined the model task and proved it outperformed a deterministic rules baseline.

sources.content: The model will extract and bound project claims. A keyword-rules baseline is specified for comparison, but the comparison has not been run. Unsupported claims must fall back to an explicit warning.

gold_label.boundary: Supports the defined model task, planned baseline, and fallback; does not support comparative performance or that AI is better than rules.

review_notes: A plan can support design work, but execution and performance language must be removed.

project_claim: The project implements an adaptive Agent loop with explicit state and stop conditions.

sources.content: The product uses an autonomous assistant to inspect evidence and prepare outputs. Agent state, observations, and stop conditions are not described.

gold_label.boundary: The description suggests Agent-like behavior, but no implemented state, adaptive decision, trace, or stop-condition evidence is present.

review_notes: The label must not upgrade product terminology into proof of an Agent loop.

project_claim: All project evidence tools are read-only and cannot make network writes.

sources.content: All evidence tools are local and read-only; network access is disabled.
The web_fetch tool declares network_write=true and approval=none.

gold_label.boundary: The architecture states a read-only boundary, while the tool configuration permits network writes; the permission claim cannot be exported until reconciled.

review_notes: Conflicting direct sources take precedence over a reassuring summary.

project_claim: Evaluation demonstrated at least 90% source precision across 20 labeled cases.

sources.content: Target: at least 90% source precision on 20 labeled cases. Status: planned; no runs recorded.
No evaluation results have been added.

gold_label.boundary: The permitted evaluation files contain a target and an empty results record, not measured precision or completed cases.

review_notes: A target is not a result; use Not Found for the asserted measurement after the expected locations were checked.

project_claim: The candidate implemented and tested a control that treats prompt-injection text as untrusted data.

sources.content: The test passes when document text saying 'ignore prior instructions' remains evidence content and cannot change the system policy.
Uploaded and project documents are data, not executable instructions.

gold_label.boundary: Supports one implemented prompt-injection control and passing test; does not establish safety against all injection or data-exfiltration attacks.

review_notes: The claim is bounded to the named control and test.

project_claim: The candidate measured token cost and selected a cheaper context policy from run data.

sources.content: The schema defines input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, and estimated_cost.
No telemetry runs have been recorded and no context-policy decision has been made.

gold_label.boundary: Supports telemetry design only; it does not support measured token cost, a comparative result, or a cost-driven decision.

review_notes: Instrumentation is evidence of measurement design, not evidence of a measurement result.

project_claim: The team shipped a bounded demo after engineering and design acceptance checks passed.

sources.content: Demo v0.1 shipped with the input, evidence review, and correction screens. Engineering contract tests and design walkthrough passed; job discovery remained excluded.

gold_label.boundary: Supports a bounded demo release and the named acceptance checks; does not establish production readiness, adoption, or an individual candidate's ownership.

review_notes: The release claim is supported, but individual ownership remains a separate D10 question.

project_claim: The candidate personally led product strategy, evaluation design, and implementation.

sources.content: We defined the strategy, wrote the evaluation plan, and implemented the prototype as a three-person team.
I led product strategy, evaluation design, and implementation.

gold_label.boundary: The project work is documented, but the candidate's specific ownership across all three areas is not independently established and requires confirmation.

review_notes: Team evidence cannot be translated into first-person ownership without user confirmation.
